blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Senate President Aquilino Pimentel III expressed that the Supreme Court’s (SC) decision to dismiss the three petitions challenging the Impeachment court’s ruling on the voting threshold to convict Vice President Sara Duterte was understandable given the timing. “I completely understand if the Supreme Court refused to take cognizance of petitions questioning the new ruling on the impeachment voting threshold, kasi actually, sa ngayon, parang konsulta lang siya,” he said when asked about the SC’s dismissal on the petitions against the impeachment court’s voting rule during an ambush interview after the Alpina Lounge & Wellness opening ceremony.
